name: Panchmel Dal
subtitle: five lentils cooked together and finished with a ghee, hing and red chilli tadka

ingredients.note: half in the dal, half in the final tadka
use compounded-free hing to keep this gluten-free
or a squeeze of lemon at the table

prepNotes: Rinse the five dals together until the water runs clear, then soak 30 minutes. Chana dal is the slowest of them and soaking evens out the cooking.
This is the dal that goes with dal baati, so make it thinner than you think. It should pour, not sit.
Keep the tadka ingredients within reach; the last step takes under a minute.

steps.text: Drain the soaked dals and pressure-cook with the turmeric, 1 tbsp ghee and 900ml water for 4 whistles, then let the pressure drop naturally.
steps.tip: The ghee in the cooker stops the dal frothing up into the vent.

steps.text: Whisk the cooked dal briefly. It should be soft but the chana dal still recognisable, not a puree.
Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a separate pan, crackle 1 tsp cumin with the bay leaf and cloves.
Add the ginger and green chilli and fry 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the coriander powder, chilli powder and half the hing off the heat for 10 seconds, then add the tomato and cook 4 minutes until it breaks down.
steps.tip: Ground spices burn in hot ghee. Always take the pan off the flame first.

steps.text: Pour this into the dal with the salt and the remaining water, and simmer 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until it thickens to a pouring consistency.
Stir in the amchur and garam masala and taste for salt and sourness.
For the final tadka, heat the last 2 tbsp ghee, crackle the remaining cumin, add the broken red chillies and the rest of the hing, and pour it over the dal while it is still foaming.
steps.tip: Pour it on at the table. The noise and the smell are half the point.

steps.text: Scatter the coriander leaves and serve with baati or bajre ki roti.

storage: Keeps 4 days refrigerated and thickens considerably. Reheat with 100ml water per portion and refresh with a small ghee-and-cumin tadka. Freezes for a month.
